decisions.reason: Transferring active prize tickets with the NFT does not change the amount, structure, disclosure, pool funding, or ticket-creation behavior of secondary royalties.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already replaces the prior FAQ with the complete revised copy, including the active-ticket transfer statement; no additional FAQ state update is required.
The transfer rule does not change which ticket counters, badges, or referral-code attributes must appear in NFT metadata.
The ownership transfer of active prize tickets does not alter the required Base network deployment.
The source changes ownership upon NFT transfer, not ticket eligibility, expiration, burning, reset, or carry-forward behavior.
Active-ticket transfer does not change the token serial as the permanent referral code or any referral-code display location.
The source does not change the amount, trigger, or recipient selection for commissions when no referral code is supplied.
The active-ticket transfer addition does not modify badge thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment.
The source does not change ticket issuance quantities or the NFT that initially receives tickets for a coded referral mint.
The rule that active tickets later follow an NFT does not change the initial one-ticket allocation to a randomly selected existing NFT.
The source changes ownership of active tickets but does not modify manual claiming, the one-click control, or the Winners page claim surface.
Active prize-ticket transfer upon an NFT sale does not affect the Transak provider, supported fiat methods, conversion asset, or wallet requirements for minting.
